title: The Exhibition Where Viewers Refuse to Appear

features.name: the-gallery-that-watches-itself
features.desc-on-touch: Empty rooms with mirrors. The exhibition keeps happening, but only for itself. You are the only visitor who arrived.

features.name: the-frame-that-refuses-viewers
features.desc-on-touch: An empty frame on the wall. You watch it wait for people who chose not to come. It holds their absence perfectly.

features.name: the-mirror-that-remembers-leif
features.desc-on-touch: A mirror on the gallery wall. You see it keeps showing one moment—when one person looked into it, and the mirror never forgot.

features.name: the-dusk-that-lives-here
features.desc-on-touch: It is always late afternoon in this gallery. You watch the light refuse to change. The exhibition goes on forever in the same golden hour.

features.name: the-catalogue-no-one-opens
features.desc-on-touch: A guide to the exhibition. You see it list every work. No one has ever turned a page, but the catalogue keeps count of all the not-readers.

inscription: the exhibition continues in perfect silence; no one comes to see it, and so it is never disappointed

file.name: Exhibition_Catalogue_Where_Viewers_Refuse.txt
file.note: A record of artworks no one visited. Each entry notes the absence of viewers with perfect precision. The last entry is undated.

reverie.title: REVERIE — gallery at closing time
narr: She stands in front of the mirror. You both stand there,
looking at the reflection of a place no one else will ever
see. The gallery is perfect because it's empty. Because
no one came to disappoint it. She touches the mirror's edge.
One person came. One person is enough. The exhibition will
remember this moment, and refuse to let anyone else in.
